title: Ecclesiastes Bible Quiz - Chapter 5
description: Ten questions on Ecclesiastes 5: guarding your steps in God's house, paying your vows, the love of silver, and enjoying labor as God's gift.

questions.text: When you go to God's house, what is better than giving the sacrifice of fools?
questions.explanation: The verse says to guard your steps when you go to God's house, for to draw near to listen is better than to give the sacrifice of fools.

answers.text: To sing with a loud voice

questions.text: Why should your words be few before God, according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: The verse says not to be rash with your mouth, for God is in heaven and you on earth; therefore let your words be few.

answers.text: For the fool speaks in the gate
For God is in heaven, and you on earth
For many words bring many friends

questions.text: What should you do when you vow a vow to God?
questions.explanation: The verse says that when you vow a vow to God, don't defer to pay it, for he has no pleasure in fools; pay that which you vow.

answers.text: Wait a year before paying it
Tell it to the messenger first

questions.text: According to this chapter, what is better than vowing and not paying?
questions.explanation: The verse says it is better that you should not vow, than that you should vow and not pay.

questions.text: What does this chapter say about him who loves silver?
questions.explanation: The verse says he who loves silver shall not be satisfied with silver, nor he who loves abundance with increase; this also is vanity.

answers.text: He shall bury it in the earth
He shall not be satisfied with silver
He shall lend to many nations

questions.text: Whose sleep does this chapter call sweet?
questions.explanation: The verse says the sleep of a laboring man is sweet, whether he eats little or much, but the abundance of the rich will not allow him to sleep.

questions.text: What grievous evil had the speaker seen under the sun?
questions.explanation: The verse speaks of a grievous evil: wealth kept by its owner to his harm.

answers.text: Wealth kept by its owner to his harm
A field that gives no harvest

questions.text: How shall a man go again, just as he came out of his mother's womb?
questions.explanation: The verse says that as he came out of his mother's womb, naked shall he go again as he came, and shall take nothing for his labor.

questions.text: What did the speaker see to be good and proper for a man all the days of his life?
questions.explanation: He says that what he has seen to be good and proper is for one to eat and to drink and to enjoy good in all his labor, for this is his portion.

answers.text: To eat, drink and enjoy good in his labor
To store up wealth for the son after him
To make many vows in God's house
To seek the favor of the king

questions.text: What does this chapter call it when God gives a man riches and the power to eat of it and rejoice in his labor?
questions.explanation: The verse says that when God gives a man riches and wealth and power to eat of it, take his portion and rejoice in his labor, this is the gift of God.
